name: Salmon (Boaz's father)
title: Patriarch of the tribe of Judah
summary: Salmon was a man from the tribe of Judah who, according to tradition, married Rahab from Jericho. He was the father of Boaz and thus an important ancestor in the lineage of David and Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Salmon is mentioned as the son of Nahshon and the father of Boaz in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Marriage with Rahab
keyEvents.description: According to the Gospel of Matthew, Salmon married Rahab, the woman who hid the spies in Jericho.

keyEvents.title: Father of Boaz
keyEvents.description: Salmon became the father of Boaz, who later married the Moabite woman Ruth and became the great-grandfather of King David.

keyEvents.title: In the lineage of the Messiah
keyEvents.description: Salmon is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus Christ, confirming his place in the messianic line.
